div.div: Every mascot is declarative JSON — parts, materials, bones. Recolour live with setPalette(), remix with variant(), or generate via agents.

div.div: Includes Copy-for-Agent prompts on the playground, llms.txt documentation, and an embedded AGENTS.md inside the npm package.

div.style: background:#16181d; border:1px solid rgba(242, 239, 230, 0.14); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px;
div.div: Honours prefers-reduced-motion, automatically sleeps when scrolled off-screen, and shares a single WebGL context across a whole cast.
